name: Final Dreams: The Gerophid Effect
storyline:
Samuel, Rebecca, Joehart, and Teana set out on a mission for the Eternal Council of Firis.

Across the regions surrounding Firis, the world has begun to shift. Weather patterns falter. Seasons slip out of rhythm. And when the legendary Zalestians - the gods worshipped by the people of Gelusia - appear at the same time, the conclusion is hard to ignore:
The Zalestians are disrupting the balance.
The first signs are already spreading across Firis: an unnatural winter, steadily expanding, slowly swallowing the land.

The group is among the last in Gelusia able to use the power of Arkan - an ancient arcane force once thought lost. With their Arkan Blades in hand, they may be the only ones who can stand against threats of divine origin.

Their path leads toward Xarveris, following the faint traces of the corruption as it grows.
summary: Final Dreams: The Gerophid Effect is a story-driven JRPG set in the handcrafted fantasy world of Gelusia. Players guide a party of four heroes through the wilds of Xarveris, exploring handcrafted maps, talking with its inhabitants and fighting in real-time, cooldown-based party combat as they follow the traces of a spreading corruption.
